name: Pride Siding, Roofing & Seamless Gutters

items.title: Your number isn't tap-to-call
items.detail: Your phone number is on the page as plain text, not a tap-to-call link, so on many phones people have to copy it by hand.
items.fix: Turn the plain-text number into a tap-to-call link and repeat it at the top of the page.

items.title: No Google Analytics
items.detail: We couldn't find Google Analytics on the site, so it's hard to tell which visits turn into calls.
items.fix: Add Google Analytics, and count calls and form fills as conversions, so you can see which visits and ads bring in jobs.

items.title: No quote form on the homepage
items.detail: There's no quote form on the homepage, so people have to find your Contact page first.
items.fix: Three quick questions on the homepage, and every answer goes to your phone in seconds.
items.fixTitle: Add a short quote form up top

good: Has a search description for Google
